requirements.quote:
A TLS-compliant application MUST implement the TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
   [GCM] cipher suite and SHOULD implement the TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
   [GCM] and TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256 [RFC8439] cipher suites (see
   Appendix B.4).
requirements.condition: in the absence of an application profile standard specifying otherwise
requirements.why_checkable: The application's cipher-suite registry and handshake negotiation can be checked for TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 support.

requirements.quote:
A TLS-compliant application MUST support digital signatures with
   rsa_pkcs1_sha256 (for certificates), rsa_pss_rsae_sha256 (for
   CertificateVerify and certificates), and ecdsa_secp256r1_sha256.
requirements.condition: in the absence of an application profile standard specifying otherwise
requirements.why_checkable: Certificate signature-algorithm support can be inspected and exercised with an rsa_pkcs1_sha256-signed certificate.

requirements.quote:
A
   TLS-compliant application MUST support key exchange with secp256r1
   (NIST P-256) and SHOULD support key exchange with X25519 [RFC7748].
requirements.condition: in the absence of an application profile standard specifying otherwise
requirements.why_checkable: The supported-group registry and a secp256r1 handshake can verify key-exchange support.
